note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase, PSNProfiles). Guides are written for this entry in its own words; each names its sources and never copies them.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. It pops the moment the last one lands, so there is nothing extra to do. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4/10 and about 200 hours, with no online trophies and only one that can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is one of the first missions of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy: it unlocks when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy: it unlocks when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy: it unlocks when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy: it unlocks when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission, the last beat of Chapter 5. A story trophy and the only hidden gold; it cannot be missed, and the credits roll right after.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx notes the bar is lenient, about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons. This is the hardest trophy and most of the roughly 200-hour run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts; any 250 of the 397 in the game count, and 300 count toward 100%. Stunt jumps, near misses and airtime all feed it, so grind the marked stunt jumps after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once, nine in all. Sample everything as you play — races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and more — and it pops when the last type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Learn each range's weapon and scoring first, then gold them one by one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per spot is enough, and all 42 races count toward 100%. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40. Winning the same race twice does not count, so work through the race list and tick off fresh wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so take the challenge when it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play a full game through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. His strand runs through the story; finish his last job.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish his last job.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some strands count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Take stranger missions as they appear and keep count of the ones that qualify.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish his last job.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish his last job.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy that can be missed: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note that 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the missable spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only. The exact animal is not confirmed yet by PowerPyx or GTABase, so check the current guides when you get there.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets, any three.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any mix counts: Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Photograph or tag them as you explore.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; 70 count toward 100%. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and the counter runs in the background as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the wanted level alive across all three robberies: plan a route of three nearby shops and keep moving.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them; 200 of the 277 base models count toward 100%. Scan new vehicles whenever you see them: the counter rewards variety, not repeats.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first, then trigger it with an assault rifle in a busy fight and chain five kills before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhinos in the description are the tanks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door: use it to slip in and out unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, out of 8. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. A bank vault job counts too if you get away clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to unfog the far corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs, one per gang; all 39 operations count toward 100%. Work through the gang list and hit one operation for each.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet by PowerPyx or GTABase, so check the current guides; the description points to ordering a drink at an Ocean Beach bar with the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Unconfirmed, but the description points to driving out through the showroom window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia; working out together trains both.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Rack up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.target_note: actions that change your Criminal Profile

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet by PowerPyx or GTABase; it appears to reward succeeding on a second attempt, so check the current guides.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is not confirmed yet; it appears tied to witnessing something strange in the world, so check the current guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet; knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, then check the current guides.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, and Yasmani pays the most, so keep feeding bills to your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. It accumulates through normal play: weapons, clothes, food and cars all count.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
